questions.prompt: Why is `struct Point{T<:Real} x::T; y::T end` (parametric `struct`) preferred over `struct Point x::Real; y::Real end`?

options.text: `Point{Float64}` has concrete field types so Julia stores unboxed floats inline; `x::Real` has an abstract field type causing heap boxing!

questions.prompt: What does `do`-block syntax in `map(xs) do x; x^2; end` do?

options.text: Passes an anonymous function as the *first* argument to `map` (ideal for `open(...) do io ... end` resource cleanup)

questions.prompt: What does `open("data.txt", "r") do io; read(io, String); end` guarantee?

options.text: Automatically closes `io` when the `do` block finishes or throws an exception

questions.prompt: What does `sum(x^2 for x in 1:1_000_000)` use?

options.text: A lazy generator expression that computes the sum in $O(1)$ heap memory

questions.prompt: What does `Union{Int, Nothing}` represent on a function return or field?

options.text: A small union type that can hold either an `Int` or `nothing` (optimized by Julia's union-splitting)

questions.prompt: What does `something(x, 0)` do in Julia?

options.text: Returns the first argument that is not `nothing` (throwing an error if all are `nothing`)

questions.prompt: What does `@test a ≈ b` (isapprox) check in `using Test`?

options.text: Approximate floating-point equality within tolerances (`isapprox(a, b)`), avoiding `0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3` failures

Select all true statements about Julia broadcasting (`f.(...)` and `.=`). (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `Ref(x)` wraps a collection/struct so broadcasting treats `x` as a scalar instead of iterating over it
`@. y = a * x + b` applies `.` to every call and operator in the expression
Broadcasting always allocates one temporary array per operator in `sin.(cos.(x))`
Broadcasts across matching or singleton (`1`) dimensions automatically

questions.prompt: What does `Threads.@threads for i in eachindex(a)` do?

options.text: Distributes loop iterations across available Julia worker threads (`julia -t auto`)

questions.prompt: Why is `eachindex(a)` preferred over `1:length(a)` when indexing generic arrays?

options.text: `eachindex` works safely with OffsetArrays and chooses the most efficient index type (linear vs CartesianIndex)

questions.prompt: What does `filter(isodd, 1:6)` return?
What does `sort!(xs; by = x -> x.score, rev = true)` do?

options.text: Sorts `xs` in place in descending order by `.score`

questions.prompt: What does `try ... catch e ... finally ... end` guarantee?

options.text: `finally` always runs (cleanup) whether the `try` block succeeded or threw an exception

questions.prompt: Match each Julia diagnostic macro to what it measures or checks.

questions.prompt: Why should you NOT benchmark a function by timing its very first call with `@time`?

options.text: The first call includes JIT compilation time and compiler allocations; time the second call (or use `BenchmarkTools.@btime`)

questions.prompt: What does `isa(x, AbstractVector)` (or `x isa AbstractVector`) check?

options.text: Returns `true` if `x`'s runtime type is a subtype of `AbstractVector`

questions.prompt: What does `convert(Float64, 3)` do vs `Float64(3)`?

options.text: Both return `3.0::Float64`; `convert(T, x)` is the generic protocol used by typed containers and assignments

questions.prompt: What does `eltype(xs)` return?

options.text: The element type of collection `xs` (e.g., `Float64` for `Vector{Float64}`)

questions.prompt: What does `rethrow()` inside a `catch` block do?

options.text: Re-raises the caught exception while preserving its original stacktrace

questions.prompt: What does `Base.@kwdef struct Config host::String = "localhost"; port::Int = 8080 end` generate?

options.text: A keyword constructor `Config(port=9000)` with default field values

questions.prompt: What does `copy(v)` vs `deepcopy(v)` do for a `Vector` of mutable structs?

options.text: `copy(v)` creates a new outer `Vector` sharing the same element references (shallow); `deepcopy(v)` recursively copies nested mutable objects

questions.prompt: What does `Val(N)` (`struct Val{x} end`) allow in Julia?

options.text: Lifting a compile-time constant value (like `Val(4)` or `Val(:json)`) into the type domain so multiple dispatch can specialize on it

questions.prompt: What does `names(MyModule)` return?

options.text: Symbols of all `export`ed names in `MyModule` (pass `all=true` to include non-exported)

questions.prompt: What does `String(take!(io))` on an `IOBuffer` do?

options.text: Extracts accumulated bytes from the in-memory `IOBuffer` as a `String` and resets the buffer efficiently

questions.prompt: What is a method ambiguity error in Julia?

options.text: When two methods like `f(x::Int, y::Real)` and `f(x::Real, y::Int)` both match `f(1, 2)` and neither is strictly more specific

questions.prompt: What does `Base.isempty(coll)` check?

options.text: Whether `coll` has zero elements (`true` for `[]`, `""`, `Dict()`) without computing full length on lazy iterables

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `SubString` and `view` in Julia. (Select all that apply.)

Mutating elements of a `view` mutates the underlying parent array `A`
